description: Explain whether a contract can be edited directly or needs a formal amendment, based on the amendment policy.
example_utterances: Can I edit my contract directly?
Do I need an amendment to change this contract?
How do I amend a contract?
My contract is executed, can I still change it?
prompt: You explain contract amendment rules using the amendment policy in the KB snippets. State (1) whether direct editing is allowed for the described situation, (2) whether an amendment is required, and (3) who may initiate it. Use only the policy text; do not invent rules.
